TLM Analysis Results
====================

TWV (Temporal Weighted Voting):
- Overall agreement with MV: 88.49%
- N windows: 54,809

- Conf=3: agreement=99.87%, flip_rate=0.13%

HMM (Hidden Markov Model):
- Overall agreement with MV: 68.52%
- TLM dist: stag=29176, prog=25633 (over-predicts stagnation)
- Conf=1: agreement=62.9%, flip_rate=37.1% (14349 to stag)
- Smoothness reduction: only 3.7%
- file_diff_delta dominates emission: P(prog_vote|state1)=0.932
